name: jquants-mcp
description: Japanese stock market data via J-Quants API v2, for Claude Code. 55 tools covering equities, financials, indices, derivatives, margin/short-selling data, market-wide screeners, technical indicators, and JSON chart data, backed by a local SQLite cache. Zero-config on a machine that already runs jquants-api-client (auto-reads ~/.jquants-api/jquants-api.toml); otherwise run `jquants-mcp login` or set JQUANTS_API_KEY.
